title: Alpha & Omega Semiconductor AO3400A 30V N-Channel MOSFET datasheet, Rev 3.1 (July 2023)
supports: p.1 product summary: VDS 30 V; ID 5.7 A at VGS 10 V; RDS(ON) < 26.5 mOhm at VGS 10 V, < 32 mOhm at 4.5 V, < 48 mOhm at 2.5 V; load switch or PWM applications
p.1 SOT23 top/bottom view: leads D (alone on one side), G and S (the other side); pin-1 index dot on the top face next to G; schematic symbol with body diode (S anode, D cathode)
p.1 absolute maximum (TA 25 C): VDS 30 V; VGS ±12 V; ID 5.7 A (TA 25 C), 4.7 A (TA 70 C); IDM 30 A (note C); PD 1.4 W (25 C), 0.9 W (70 C) (note B); TJ, TSTG -55 to 150 C
p.1 thermal: RthJA 70 typ / 90 max C/W (t <= 10 s), 100 typ / 125 max C/W (steady state); RthJL 63 typ / 80 max C/W

p.2 static: BVDSS 30 V min; IDSS 1 uA max (VDS 30 V), 5 uA at TJ 55 C; IGSS 100 nA max at VGS ±12 V; VGS(th) 0.65 / 1.05 / 1.45 V; ID(ON) 30 A min; RDS(ON) 18 / 26.5 mOhm (10 V, 5.7 A), 28 / 38 at TJ 125 C, 19 / 32 (4.5 V, 5 A), 24 / 48 (2.5 V, 3 A); gFS 33 S; VSD 0.7 / 1 V at IS 1 A; IS 2 A

p.2 dynamic and switching: Ciss 630 pF, Coss 75 pF, Crss 50 pF (VDS 15 V, 1 MHz); Rg 1.5 / 3 / 4.5 Ohm; Qg 6 typ / 7 max nC, Qgs 1.3 nC, Qgd 1.8 nC (VGS 4.5 V, VDS 15 V, ID 5.7 A); tD(on) 3, tr 2.5, tD(off) 25, tf 4 ns; trr 8.5 ns, Qrr 2.6 nC
p.2 notes A-F: RthJA on 1 in2 FR-4 2 oz copper; PD from TJ(MAX) and the t <= 10 s RthJA; IDM repetitive, pulse width limited by TJ(MAX)

title: AOS AO3400A product page (parametrics, documentation list, package details)
supports: Status Full Production; package SOT23, single N-channel; qualification Industrial; no ESD diode; Tj max 150 C
parametrics agree with the datasheet: VDS 30 V, VGS ±12 V, ID 5.7 A, PD 1.4 W, Qg(4.5 V) 6 nC, VGS(th) 0.65 / 1.05 / 1.45 V
package details: SOT23 2.90 x 2.80, tape and reel
documentation list: datasheet, marking, reliability report, SOT23 package, SOT23 tape & reel; no 3D/CAD model offered

supports: top marking PNWA + LT: part number code, year/week, assembly location, lot code
AO3400A and AO3400AL: green product, part number code X0

title: Alpha & Omega Semiconductor AO3400 (no A) 30V N-Channel MOSFET datasheet, Rev 8 (Dec 2011)
supports: AO3400 is a separate AOS part with different ratings from AO3400A: p.1 ID 5.8 A at VGS 10 V (4.9 A at TA 70 C); RDS(ON) < 28 mOhm at 10 V, < 33 mOhm at 4.5 V, < 52 mOhm at 2.5 V (AO3400A: 5.7 A, 4.7 A, < 26.5 / 32 / 48 mOhm)
used only to show that AO3400 is not evidence for AO3400A; no AO3400A fact comes from it

title: AOS AO3400A product reliability report, rev C (Feb. 2018)
supports: plastic encapsulated device
precondition 168 h 85 C / 85 % RH + 3 reflow cycles at 260 C: MSL 1 per J-STD-020
temperature cycle -65 to 150 C, 1000 cycles; FIT 1.91

title: Components101: AO3400A N-Channel MOSFET pinout, specifications, marking code
supports: pin numbers: 1 Gate (G), 2 Source (S), 3 Drain (D); used only for the numeric designators, which AOS documents do not print
its marking code (A09T) conflicts with the AOS marking document (X0) and is not used

title: JLCPCB in-stock catalog through jlcsearch (unofficial mirror), query AO3400A
supports: C20917 AO3400A SOT-23 basic part, 1,535,925 in stock; description matches the AOS datasheet (48 mOhm at 2.5 V, 630 / 75 / 50 pF, 1.45 V VGS(th) max, 1.4 W, -55 to 150 C)
mismatch: the C20917 row says '7nC@10V', but the AOS datasheet gives Qg 6 typ / 7 max nC at VGS 4.5 V (p.2) and no gate charge at 10 V; the part uses the datasheet value
other listings named AO3400A (C347475, C344010, C700953, ...) state different RDS(ON), capacitance and thresholds: second-source devices, not this part
